_comment: Species, models and image sources offered by scripts/gui_app.py. Format: src/detect/species.py. This is the repository version (needs data/raw and data/yolo on this machine); the portable version for another machine is configs/gui_species_bundle.json.

sources.label: zExtra — never seen (unlabelled)
sources.name: zExtra
sources.note: **zExtra** is the one set the model has never seen in any form — excluded from every dataset version, never labelled, never trained on, never evaluated (D-003). It is the honest answer to *how does this behave on data it has never met*. There is no ground truth here, so a miss and a correct rejection look identical.
